Design.title: Design system
Design.lead: Colours, type, motifs and components that shape Tachawit. Everything here is built from design tokens.
Design.typeDisplay: Display: Noto Serif Display and Reem Kufi
Design.typeBody: Body: Noto Sans and Noto Sans Arabic
Design.bodySample: Audio comes first: every word is recorded by a native speaker, and every lesson is short enough for a bus ride.

Design.cardBody: Cards hold one idea at a time, like a single lesson step.
Design.motifsLead: Borders and textures inspired by Chaoui weaving, pottery and silver jewelry, with the Tifinagh ⵣ as our mark.
Design.tachawitLead: Every Tachawit word follows the script chosen in the header. When a script is missing, it falls back to Latin.
